name: ZOPS - 轻松搞定运维工作
name_zh: ZOPS - 轻松搞定运维工作
description: Operate a Linux server through your own ZOPS panel: inspect load, disks, Docker containers, the Caddy gateway, logs and cron jobs, and — only after you approve — restart a container, reload the gateway or edit the Caddyfile.
description_zh: 通过你自己机器上的 ZOPS 面板运维服务器：查看负载、磁盘、Docker 容器、Caddy 网关、日志与定时任务；会话改动状态的操作（重启容器、重载网关、改 Caddyfile）会先说明影响和回滚方式，等你确认再动手。面板地址与令牌只存本机。
description_en: Operate a Linux server through your own ZOPS panel: inspect load, disks, Docker containers, the Caddy gateway, logs and cron jobs. State-changing actions (restarting a container, reloading the gateway, editing the Caddyfile) are explained with their impact and rollback first, and only run after you approve. Panel address and token stay on your machine.
examples_zh: 服务器现在什么情况？先看一眼负载、磁盘和内存。
哪个容器在反复重启？把它的日志最后 200 行读出来给我看。
网站 502 了：查一下网关日志和 Caddyfile，确认反代目标端口有没有人在听。
把 disk-usage-check 这个定时任务立刻跑一次，然后把结果告诉我。
停掉 staging-web 这个容器 —— 先说清楚影响谁、怎么回滚，我确认了再执行。
examples_en: What is the state of this server? Start with load, disk and memory.
Which container keeps restarting? Read the last 200 lines of its log.
The site returns 502: check the gateway logs and the Caddyfile, and confirm something is actually listening on the reverse-proxy target port.
Run the disk-usage-check scheduled task once right now, then report the result.
Stop the staging-web container — explain who is affected and how to roll back first, and only do it after I confirm.
